meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

copy.tagline: 简化药物研发中的分子分析工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做药物研发,常需要用代码处理化学数据。
copy.tagline_en: Simplify molecular analysis in drug research and development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in drug discovery and want a friendlier way to process molecular data.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 datamol 处理分子数据:解析 SMILES、标准化结构、计算描述符与指纹、聚类、生成 3D 构象、读写分子文件,返回 RDKit 原生 Mol 对象。
howto.when: 当你要求做分子数据处理——如解析 SMILES、标准化结构、计算描述符等——它会接管;需要高级自定义参数时则改用 rdkit。

say.text: 把这些 SMILES 标准化,并算出分子量、logP 等描述符
say.note: 先标准化再批量计算描述符

say.text: 用 ECFP4 指纹算这批分子之间的相似度距离矩阵
给这个分子生成 50 个 3D 构象并做聚类
say.note: 生成构象后按 RMSD 聚类

howto.what_en: With datamol installed, Claude parses SMILES, standardizes structures, computes descriptors and fingerprints, clusters molecules, generates 3D conformers, and reads/writes molecule files. Returns native RDKit Mol objects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for molecule work such as SMILES parsing, standardization, or descriptors; for advanced custom parameters, rdkit is used instead.

say_en.text: Standardize these SMILES and compute descriptors like MW and logP
Compute a similarity distance matrix for these molecules with ECFP4
Generate 50 3D conformers for this molecule and cluster them
say_en.note: Generates conformers, then clusters by RMSD
